question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Waxed and waned**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "Increased and decreased". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Waxed and waned"** refers to something that alternately increases and decreases in size, strength, or intensity over a period of time. (बढ़ना और घटना) • **Example:** His interest in the project waxed and waned over the years. • **"Increased and decreased"** means a fluctuation between growing and diminishing, which is the exact meaning of the idiom "waxed and waned." (बढ़ा और घटा) • **Example:** The company's sales figures waxed and waned with the changing market trends. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Grown steadily** (लगातार बढ़ना): Refers to continuous or consistent growth without any decline. • **Example:** His confidence has grown steadily since he started his new job. • **Option 3: Expanded and contracted rapidly** (तेजी से फैलना और सिकुड़ना): Refers to something that increases and decreases quickly in size or volume. • **Example:** The balloon expanded and contracted rapidly due to the air pressure changes. • **Option 4: Became fixed and stable** (स्थिर और स्थायी हो गया): Refers to something becoming steady and unchanging. • **Example:** After years of instability, his life finally became fixed and stable. 3e:T666, The correct answer is **option 1.**
